title: Patch: Help-aimed buffs land stolen and random casts on the caster's side
notes: Fortify, Hopeful Jelly Bean, Divine Spirit, Power Word Shield, Plastanium, Metaglass, Surge Alloy and Graphite declare aim Help on their side-any targets (R656), so Palantir steals, Solarius Prime casts, Appropriations targets and Lucky rerolls land them on the caster's side; each keeps its aim-less script under v0.6.13h. Sweep of every side-any target with no aim (98 files; 26 match only in a scope or effect such as damage_all, fill_board or set_stats_all, with no TargetDecl to aim, and are untouched): changed traininggrounds-012, traininggrounds-027, stinkyscape-010-2, stinkyscape-010-3, stinkyscapeplus-045, stinkyscapeplus-047, stinkyscapeplus-049, stinkyscapeplus-050 (every effect on the target can only help it: buffs, Radiant, Divine Shield, Ranged, Rush, Charge, Windfury, Pierce, Deft, Frenzy, First Strike). Left: damage to the target (classic-019, classic-036, classic-059, classic-083, classicplus-059, classicplus-076-1, core-031, core-035, core-044, core-068, core-070, core-093-1, core-074, meditative-005, meditative-039-3, stinkyscape-003, stinkyscape-011-1, stinkyscapeplus-001, stinkyscapeplus-038, traininggrounds-011, traininggrounds-058); destroy, exile, bounce or shuffle of the target (classic-048, classicplus-012-1, classicplus-032-1, classicplus-032-2, core-016, core-034, core-036, meditative-024, stinkyscape-009, stinkyscape-012-1, stinkyscape-012-2, stinkyscape-020, stinkyscape-099, stinkyscapeplus-004, stinkyscapeplus-085, stinkyscapeplus-104, traininggrounds-026, traininggrounds-046); Freeze (stinkyscape-001, stinkyscape-002, stinkyscapeplus-022); removal of what the target has, Vanilla, De-Radiant or Plague Counters (classicplus-009, classic-039, classic-078, meditative-053, stinkyscapeplus-019); Brittle, lock, Dormant, kill-deadline, Immutable or Immune to Spells (stinkyscapeplus-048, stinkyscapeplus-044, stinkyscapeplus-051, stinkyscapeplus-094, stinkyscapeplus-046, all of which can harm the target); set-stats or shift whose help depends on the target (traininggrounds-034, stinkyscape-010-1); damage-or-heal duals and hero setters whose help depends on the mode or target (classicplus-012-2, classicplus-065-2, classicplus-065-3, core-024, classic-029); copies that leave the target unchanged (core-061, traininggrounds-053, traininggrounds-037); Duo plus Radiant (stinkyscape-110, the Duo can harm); a random Fruit that can harm (stinkyscape-141).

player.title: Stolen buffs help the thief
fixes: Stolen or random casts that aim at enemies now land Fortify, Hopeful Jelly Bean, Divine Spirit and Power Word Shield on the caster's own side.
Surge Alloy, Plastanium, Metaglass and Graphite land the same way now, instead of buffing the enemy.
